sentences.en: A radical disarmament treaty prohibits all armaments and armed forces.
sentences.zh: 一项彻底的裁军条约禁止所有武器和武装部队。

sentences.en: Aart got more and more radical as time went on.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，Aart变得越来越激进。

sentences.en: No one wants radical Islamists to take power in Algeria.
sentences.zh: 没有人希望激进的伊斯兰主义者在阿尔及利亚掌权。
